payload.text: `wip.md` and `inbox.<sender>.md` are 100% generated views rendered from the store: regeneration reproduces the committed bytes exactly, byte-identical on two renders of the same store, their one writer the renderer and the formatter excluded from them as from every generated view (ST0056 AC-03.17), so that `intent doctor` reports a hand edit of either as view skew. Reworded 2026-09-12 under the pen: the minted text asked for a formatter fixed point, which contradicts the generated-view rule the same way AC-01.1 did before its rewording.
